title: Orthogonal and even-dimensional symplectic twisted Yangians over C[hbar] as the specified graded limits of twisted quantum loop algebras
author: Patrick Conner; Nicolas Guay
source_title: From Twisted Quantum Loop Algebras to Twisted Yangians
difficulty_reason: The proof constructs a filtration adapted simultaneously to q approaching1 and the loop parameter approaching1, then identifies the leading twisted RTT generators. Its supporting untwisted degeneration proves injectivity by tensor evaluation and differential separation of PBW monomials, while a spanning argument establishes surjectivity of the twisted associated graded map.
source_version: Official SIGMA 11 (2015) article 040, DOI 10.3842/SIGMA.2015.040; journal PDF and native TeX acquired 2026-10-01, exact bytes pinned by SHA256

proof_review.method: Published author proof/core and local context fidelity screening
proof_review.note: Complete Theorem3.2, Theorem3.1 compatibility, Lemma3.1/Corollary3.1 and the full supporting Theorem2.2 proof read. The limit is the explicitly defined graded algebra of ideals K_m^tw in the local integral form, not the naive q=1 specialization. Orthogonal o_N and symplectic sp_N are covered together; the latter requires even N and the specified q-skew matrix B. Prior RTT embeddings and integral-form specialization are explicitly cited established background. The author gives the full orthogonal spanning computation and describes its corresponding symplectic computation; no additional exceptional Lie types or super-Yangians are selected.

statement_scope: Full Theorem3.2 for g_N=o_N or sp_N over C (N positive, even in the symplectic case). The twisted Yangian of Definition3.1 over C[hbar] is isomorphic via s_ij^(m+1)->S_ij^(1,m) modulo K_(m+1)^tw to the explicitly defined graded limit in Section3; hbar is the graded class of q-q inverse. No claim for an unfiltered or generic-q algebra.
source_boundary_note: The complete original twisted graded-limit isomorphism Theorem 3.2 and all author twisted and supporting untwisted degeneration proof are retained. Both o_N and sp_N cases keep their original RTT/integral-form conventions, with even N and the q-skew B matrix in the symplectic case. The full two-parameter filtration, evaluation/differential separation of untwisted PBW monomials, twisted compatibility and leading-generator spanning/surjectivity calculation are supplied. The source maps s_ij^(m+1) to the class of S_ij^(1,m) in K_m^tw/K_(m+1)^tw; hbar is the class of q-q inverse. Prior RTT embeddings/specialization are cited established background; the corresponding symplectic spanning computation is the bounded author-described adaptation. No naive q=1, unfiltered/generic-q, exceptional-type or super-Yangian extension is selected.
